articles.title: Blazar Boosted Dark Matter in IceCube

articles.summary: We introduce the problem of designing mechanisms that incentivize strategic agents to form self-funded marketplaces. articles.summary: With the rapid advancement of image editing models and their widespread application across various domains, there is an increasingly urgent need to deploy these model capabilities directly into real-world scenarios. articles.title: MagnifiQ: Patch-aware Text Guided Progressive Upscaling for High-Resolution Image Restoration
articles.summary: High-resolution image restoration from degraded inputs is challenging because it must preserve global structural consistency while recovering fine-grained local details, especially at 4K resolution where direct diffusion-based restoration is computationally expensive and prone to repeated or inconsistent textures. articles.title: Generation-Powered Inference for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
articles.summary: Modern generative models increasingly produce distribution-valued outputs, such as predicted cellular responses to genetic perturbations in single-cell genomics. articles.summary: Determining the biological sex of the individuals who created Upper Paleolithic hand stencils remains a challenging problem due to the absence of ground truth, population differences between contemporary and prehistoric groups, and the uncertainty introduced by image degradation. articles.title: Finding Vulnerabilities via LLM-Augmented Semantics-Aware Type-Checking
articles.summary: Vulnerability detection via static analysis traditionally relies on security experts encoding insecure coding patterns into algorithmic rules. articles.summary: This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session handover in applications that use large language models. articles.summary: Recipe data arises in domains such as materials synthesis, pharmaceutical formulation, and industrial manufacturing, where procedures are represented as ordered sequences of steps containing heterogeneous structured fields. articles.summary: Theoretical arguments have for decades anticipated substantial weakening of tropical convection as the surface warms, yet convection-resolving models show no robust change in column-integrated convective mass transport and an increase in transported volume. articles.summary: As heterogeneous robotic systems deploy across diverse urban zones, maintaining safety amid complex human-robot interactions remains a critical challenge. articles.summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) aims to automate neural network architecture design, reducing reliance on human expertise. articles.title: Memory Allocation for Constant-Bounded Programs
articles.summary: This work studies memory allocation for constant-bounded programs, whose execution length is syntactically limited for all inputs.
